test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 13 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Name the first Indian Woman to be appointed to the International Cricket Council (ICC) as a match referee.
solution: The correct answer is __**GS Lakshmi.**__ • **India's GS Lakshmi **has become the first-ever woman referee to be appointed on the ICC International Panel of Match Referees. • Lakshmi's appointment follows close on the heels of Claire Polosak, who became the first female umpire to stand in a men's One-Day International.
